exampleEn: Even though things got tough, we decided to carry on with our plans.
exampleKo: 상황이 힘들어졌지만, 우리는 계획을 계속하기로 했다.
gameExamples: She was determined to carry on despite the obstacles in her way.
It's important to carry on with your studies, even when the going gets tough.
They agreed to carry on the meeting until all topics were covered.
